verdict.rationale: Bench is a SaaS bookkeeping service, a kind of product that could plausibly publish a developer API, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only client-facing bookkeeping, reporting, tax and banking features and never mentions a public API or API reference. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
